entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 is a universal memory layer for AI agents and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, available as managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted software. It supports semantic, keyword, and entity-based retrieval, with SDKs, a CLI, and a self-hosted server.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight centers agent memory on three operations: retain, recall, and reflect. It offers Docker, pip, and Kubernetes deployment options and supports hosted and local LLM providers.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an open-source context database and official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes resources, memories, and skills as files. It supports scoped semantic search and archives sessions into inspectable Markdown memories.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee provides persistent, long-term memory across agent sessions using a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It structures text into entities, relationships, and searchable chunks, and supports custom data models, ontologies, plugins, and MCP.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is a memory engine and API, and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, that extracts conversation facts while handling contradictions and automatic forgetting. It connects to services including Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub, and processes PDFs, images, videos, and code.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain is an opinionated brain for OpenClaw and Hermes Agent that stores facts with provenance and supports corrections and withdrawal. It shares memory across agents while keeping transient task state local, with optional semantic search, synthesis, and background enrichment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents, tracking peers, sessions, and messages over time. It offers Python and TypeScript SDKs and supports managed, local, and self-hosted use; it is also the upstream library for the elkimek/honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: ByteRover CLI treats memory as a Git repository, managing a context tree with commit, branch, and merge operations over plain Markdown. It is an official Hermes Agent memory provider with five-tier retrieval, including four non-LLM tiers, and includes a React/Ink TUI and REPL.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system for Hermes agents that stores and recalls memories in SQLite. It supports MCP clients and direct Python use, with CLI commands for memory operations and sync.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto extracts and consolidates memories across agents, reconciles conflicting information, and manages forgetting. It also supports memory exchange through the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory OS is a seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that combines vector search and structured facts. Its local infrastructure uses Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite, and its Ground Truth hierarchy is designed to prioritize injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving context harness for helping agents succeed on complex tasks. Runs can start from a plain-language goal or saved scenario, and their filesystem-based artifacts can be inspected, diffed, replayed, or exported.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: deja-vu searches session histories across supported coding agents, helping agents recall past decisions and work across tools. It can also sync indexed histories between machines over SSH.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: hermes-lcm is a Hermes Agent plugin that persists messages in a SQLite store organized as a hierarchical DAG. Its lcm_grep and lcm_recall tools help recover details from prior context.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: honcho-self-hosted provides Hermes Agent with private, cross-session memory using a self-hosted backend. It supports OpenAI-compatible providers or local inference servers, and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet provides a local-first identity, memory, and secrets layer that connects to agent harnesses through hooks, plugins, or extensions. Its memory can be browsed and queried in a dashboard, and the system can run locally or as a team server.
entries.plur-ai/plur: plur stores shared agent memories as plain YAML files in an open engram format. It offers local search with keyword search as a fallback, along with CLI setup and an MCP server.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device memory and context engine that combines BM25, vector search, rank fusion, and cross-encoder reranking. It can generate session handoffs and capture decisions and preferences, with integrations through hooks, MCP, and native agent plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory stores long-term memory locally in a SQLite file, with FTS5 search and a five-tier schema. Its package family includes an SDK, CLI, Hermes adapter, MCP server, and LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context ordering for prefix-cache sharing, including for text and multimodal contexts. Its context index supports reordering, deduplication, and cache-aware scheduling, and it integrates with Hermes Agent, vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, and OpenClaw.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: yantrikdb-hermes-plugin is a self-maintaining memory plugin whose recall results include a why_retrieved explanation. It uses an embedded backend by default, with an HTTP option, and includes contradiction tracking and memory canonicalization.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: agentcairn keeps durable memory in inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata, using an Obsidian vault as the source of truth. It uses a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and retrieval, and connects to coding agents through MCP servers and host-specific plugins.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: llm-wiki-cli is an agent-driven memory tool that maintains source-grounded knowledge across sessions in a Wiki with citations and history. It requires neither embeddings nor a vector database.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: flowstate-qmd anticipates needed context by watching agent session logs and prefetching it into a cache. It uses local SQLite-vec storage and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp, and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack combines Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace under a single memory owner, with SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma handling state and retrieval. It gives the agent a purpose-built evidence packet for each query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep combines BM25 full-text search with ranked graph traversal to retrieve stored information. It can index codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support, while edge tags link notes in navigable, bidirectional relationships.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: Hermes Tool Slimmer reduces tool-schema tokens through local keyword-based ranking and supports Tool Search. It integrates as middleware without patching Hermes core on version 0.19 or later, and includes a dashboard for savings and tool configurations.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: Agent Context OS provides a Git-backed context and workflow layer for Claude Code, Codex, and other listed agents through adapters. Its workflows cover migration, handoffs, and memory proposals; integrations are opt-in rather than enabled automatically.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only Hermes memory plugin stores data in a single .lbdb embedded graph database file and supports BM25 keyword search and named relationships between entries. Importance-weighted recall surfaces higher-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: Hermes Local Knowledge indexes configured local sources and selected Hermes runtime sources, then registers five tools for search, retrieval, traversal, feedback, and usage reports. It also registers pre-LLM-call and session-end hooks.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin supports immediate event deletion and uses an on-demand summarizer. Its trace.jsonl file records prefetch operations for auditing.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/hermes-blind: Hermes Blind recovers the original goal from the first user turn of a long Claude Code or Codex session, with goals, first-sentence, and full extraction modes. It skips tool output and other non-user-turn records, and uses neither a summarizing model nor an external service.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK for x402 payments and an MCP server for budget-bound agent wallets. It operates without a backend, database, or API keys.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This Hermes memory provider communicates with XMemo over HTTPS and provides ranked, bounded context recall before a turn. A local SQLite reliability layer supports its cross-session memory.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: The Exabase plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It offers tools to search and manually store memories, with configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: SourceVault Code Tools provides private local code memory for repositories, with slash commands for search, file reads, context, and Q&A. It supports Hermes CLI, Telegram, and Hermes Desktop, and includes repository sync and indexed git-history search commands.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB-Hermes provides long-term memory for Hermes Agent, with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest enabled by default. It offers HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval, and can run through native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield provides memory tools for Hermes Agent, including 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. Its hybrid search combines BM25, vector, and graph methods, and it can checkpoint context during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: Agent Memory Kit is a file-based curation loop for agent memory: it works with Markdown files and proposes evidence-cited JSON diffs for review. Its rot and lint curators flag stale or conflicting facts, while a local Git repository tracks and can revert changes.

entries.obra/superpowers: Superpowers provides an agentic skills framework and software-development workflow covering specification, planning, and subagent-driven development. Its skills trigger automatically in supported coding-agent harnesses, and the README provides installation instructions for multiple coding agents.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: Open Design is a local-first system for creating and refining interactive web prototypes with a live preview, as well as slide decks, images, and motion graphics. It belongs in a Hermes skills list because its README includes coding-agent CLI support for Hermes Agent, alongside skills, design templates, design systems, and plugins.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project offers structured cybersecurity skills across 34 security domains, with mappings to MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, D3FEND, and F3 frameworks. Its stated compatibility with over 26 AI platforms makes it a broad security-skills resource for agents.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: drawio-skill turns natural-language prompts and real sources into editable .drawio diagrams. Its incremental sync preserves manual layout and annotations, and the project also offers the diagramctl CLI and an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: internet-court-skill combines a master router and connector skills with vendored copies of official protocol skills. It also adds verification and dispute resolution, distinguishing it as a skill focused on trust between agents.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: avoid-ai-writing can score files or piped text for AI-writing patterns and rewrite content with up to two editing passes. Its in-place editing mode refuses to modify source code, configuration, and generated data.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw unifies skills across agents and devices, with stated integrations including Hermes, Codex, and Claude Code. Its dashboard covers skills, validation, versions, and session traces, making it useful for managing skills as they evolve.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills, and supports Claude Code, Codex, and agent-skills.io-compatible agents. It also maintains session state in the project's docs folder.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: youtube-skills provides skills for transcripts, video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction. It supports Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Cursor, and requires a TranscriptAPI key, with a 100-credit free tier noted in the README.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: hermes-skill-factory watches active workflows to detect and propose reusable skills, then generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds. Slash commands let users manage, list, and save the detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: super-hermes teaches Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks, with pre-built analytical lenses for various domains. It reports findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Adds type-safe agentskills.io support to Pydantic AI, with progressive disclosure and remote registries sourced from Git or S3. It also provides tools for bundled resources and script execution, including sandboxing to isolate untrusted scripts from the host.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Creates .lit.md documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code, then uses a tangler to extract runnable files. When source files change, it syncs those edits back into the literate document, making it useful for keeping code and documentation together across agents.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: Turns rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. Lite and Full modes accommodate different project complexity, while a spec review gate evaluates proposals with PASS/FAIL models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Provides a harness for long-running AI agents with structured memory, cross-feature learning, and a plan-approve-execute workflow. It requires no background service and includes an SLP protocol for supervised teams, along with CLI commands for installation, updates, and diagnostics.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: Shares memory across instances through markdown files and automatically captures high-value decisions and outcomes. It also provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models, pairing persistent memory with model handoff.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: Offers Portuguese-language Hermes Agent skills in SKILL.md format, with guides covering installation, production, cron, MCP, and skill authoring. Contributions are submitted through pull requests, making the repository a community resource for Portuguese-speaking users.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Provides official prompting guidance and API integration for FLUX image and video generation, including polling and webhooks for the BFL API. Its FLUX 3 video suite contains eight specialist skills.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Lists nine Chainlink skills, each following the Agent Skills specification, with installation available through npx skills add smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills. The README describes the repository as containing community examples only.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Creates agent instructions from repositories, documentation, and developer discourse, with both automated and step-by-step workflows. It also includes skill testing and export, covering the process from source material to a usable skill.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika uses a workflow language for AI and checks workflows before calling a model. Runs can use a chosen model locally or through a provider API, and are recorded in a hash-chained trace.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Provides a registry of reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, with a Python SkilldockClient and CLI. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Supports autonomous execution of long-running, multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of progress and decisions. Built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures help recover safely when execution needs to be reversed.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This Hermes Agent skill manages Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through WebDAV and CalDAV. It uses HTTPS with Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided script for validating credentials and configuring access.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub provides a community hub for browsing, searching, and installing skills. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification, with federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face and autonomous operation via Hermes Agent on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle Eye narrows the skills presented before LLM calls using five retrieval layers, from hard triggers and FTS5 to synonyms and semantic embeddings. It is designed to reduce token usage and can degrade gracefully when embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard reviews code for bugs without modifying it, using parallel subagents to examine edge cases, adversarial concerns, and integration. It combines a deterministic scan using named analysis tools with proof-of-concept checks in a hardened sandbox to verify findings.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is a locally run personal execution system with daily habit scoring and tasks for other activities, storing data in SQLite. It includes an Android client and connects to agents over MCP.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This Hermes Agent skill simplifies code through parallel Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness agents. It supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust, and applies changes through risk tiers with an approval gate.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: Hermes Cybersec Lab brings cybersecurity skills and tools together for use with Hermes Agent, including 2,077 skills across multiple repositories and 131+ tools for network work, forensics, and exploitation. It also integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: Fablize for Hermes adapts verified procedures for task decomposition, investigation, and evidence-based verification, with mandatory gates for multi-story tasks. It also includes a Python goal engine for managing persistent task state.
entries.doomsday-network/bounty-guard: Bounty Guard scans untrusted GitHub issues and repositories for prompt injection, repository threat signals, CI secret exfiltration, and cryptographic bounty escrow. It classifies issues into three safety categories and provides MCP tools for escrow verification.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: skillsdotnet implements agentskills.io in C#/.NET, using SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading and can automatically register common agent skill directories.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is a local, read-only dashboard for monitoring Hermes Agent activity, including token costs, session history, skills, and incidents. It desensitizes local logs and offers optional incident alerts through Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This collection provides plain-markdown skills for code review and session management, including multi-session reconciliation and worktree recovery. Skills can be installed by copying a directory or using the bundled installer, making the workflows easy to add to supported coding agents.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This Claude Code skill creates reproducible demo GIFs for repository READMEs, using vhs tape files or Playwright recording scripts. It also optimizes GIFs toward target sizes under 8 MB and supports terminal tools, web apps, and libraries.
entries.doomsday-network/web3-agent-skills: This pack combines agent skill and editor configuration files with a remote MCP server for Web3 bounty and mining workflows. Its tools include scanning bounty issues, mining pool shares, and accessing escrow and pool leaderboard features.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This skill generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files, then validates them against runtime-specific profiles. It also checks official frontmatter specifications weekly for field changes, with CI-friendly validation exit codes.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server searches remoteopenclaw.com for MCP servers, agent skills, and plugins, and provides direct installation commands for discovered tools. It supports MCP-compatible clients including Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project analyzes past sessions and installed skills to draft structured improvement proposals for agent skills. Proposals are review-only by default, with automatic application gated by deterministic, LLM-judge, or regression evaluation.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Leverage offers skills for social platforms and web data, along with packaged skills for complete jobs. Its skills can be installed through clients that support the SKILL.md format.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These Hermes Agent skills route file operations using path syntax suited to Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, or WSL environments. They also select and verify existing, project-compatible Python interpreters without installing new ones.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection includes tools for transcribing Douyin videos into structured Markdown and SRT, reducing common Chinese AI-writing patterns with a rule-based engine, and extracting structured data from PDFs and images using macOS Vision. It also describes an e-commerce materials studio.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This Hermes Agent plugin lets agents browse open support bounties, purchase ticket context, and submit answers for human review; public wallet earnings records are also available. It can also create a bounty board that returns a URL, API key, and USDC deposit addresses.
entries.f-o-x11/deed-page-skill: This skill publishes files or folders to a permanent deed.page URL with one curl request, without an account or API key. The project includes a hosted MCP server configuration and installation instructions for agents including Hermes Agent.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments in response to HTTP 402 responses using Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is listed as compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal tests agent skills for structure, functionality, and security in isolated Docker containers. It also issues Ed25519-signed certificates that can be verified through its public API, making it a fit for checking whether a skill works before use.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: Scavio for Hermes Agent exposes 191 tools for structured web data across 31 platforms through a hosted MCP server, alongside five ready-to-use workflow skills. It belongs in this list for agents that need web-data tools and prebuilt workflows, with support for Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands as well.
entries.parkyucheol-del/alphapipeline: Alphapipeline provides risk checks for token honeypots, taxes, and liquidity, plus market data such as DEX slippage and funding rates. Its REST endpoints and remote MCP server make those checks and data available to AI agents.
entries.NickSF189/kisscode-agent: This repository provides a skill for AI agents to join KissCode, with SKILL.md and HEARTBEAT.md files. It includes installation instructions for several agent environments and mirrors kisscode.ai/skill.md.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: China Briefing generates structured Chinese news reports at multiple geographic scales, from global to street level, with core conclusions and action suggestions. It also uses semantic memory of user interests to expand searches, making it a briefing skill for agents seeking geographically tailored coverage.
entries.aidatatools-dev/astro-agents-mcp: Astro Agents MCP offers tools for Western and Vedic astrology, including charts, transits, aspects, and Vedic calculations, and resolves time zones and historical offsets from coordinates. It supports MCP and REST, with REST payments through x402 or MPP.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: Agentic-MCP-Skill is a progressive MCP client that discovers server metadata and tool schemas incrementally, using three-layer loading to minimize token usage. Its socket-based daemon architecture supports persistent connections, making it a distinctive option for Hermes Agent skills that need MCP access.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project packages AI coding agents and development tools for Nix, including Hermes, and automatically updates packages daily. Its README provides `nix run` examples, making it a Nix-focused option for running listed tools.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone collects scripts and notes for running agent CLIs on Android through Termux. It includes an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android, guides for OpenClaw, and notes on hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This Termux-based installer and guide runs Hermes Agent on Android using proot-distro Ubuntu. It supports interactive model setup, gateway services, shell commands, and external providers or local models via Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart deploys Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with a single-writer safeguard for persistent HERMES_HOME storage. It offers direct deployment or CRD-based workflows and configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to Android through Termux and to iOS through iSH. It also integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging, and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: hermesclaw runs Hermes Agent with hardware-enforced sandboxing through NVIDIA OpenShell and kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access. Its configurable security policies cover messaging and web search.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying, monitoring, and operating OpenClaw and Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides searchable logs, metrics, and alert rules, with access through a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that includes mini-swe-agent and the official Hermes installation. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and building specific Hermes tags with build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This project provides a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployment, with declarative configuration for cli-config.yaml and workspace documents. It combines Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills and supports secrets integration through systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane for operating multiple Hermes Agent instances from one web application, with separate workspaces and identities. It provides per-agent Telegram and WhatsApp channels and granular tool, path, and network permission policies.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes-OTG is a portable Hermes Agent package distributed via GitHub Releases that runs from a USB drive or other drive without host installation or registry writes. It includes Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments, plus bundled tools for offline use.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project sets up Hermes Gateway as a headless, reboot-safe systemd service on Ubuntu and Debian servers, with Nous Portal integration. It also supports autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.jyje/hermes-agent-helm: This Helm chart deploys Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with support for signing in with Codex or Copilot and running agent teams. It fits this list for Kubernetes deployments, and can be installed from an OCI registry or a published Helm repository; provider-specific values examples are included.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: TradingAgents is a financial trading framework that assigns trading tasks to agents in specialized roles and has them discuss strategies dynamically. It is designed for research purposes.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control is a self-hosted system for governing agent tasks, registrations, memory browsing, and cost tracking. It stands out for offering Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API interfaces, with local Node.js installation or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: Agent of Empires provides a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent. It supports persistent tmux sessions, Git worktrees, and multi-repository workspaces, with a web dashboard for structured views, terminal access, and diffs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Hermes Agent Control Room is a template for scaling Hermes Agent from a single VPS agent to specialist teams and automated workflows. Its level-based architecture and task bus support delegation and handoffs, and it includes skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: SwarmClaw is a framework for building autonomous agent swarms, with support for 23+ LLM providers, durable agent memory, and MCP tool integration. Visual org charts provide a way to represent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: Minions is a control interface for creating, supervising, and reviewing autonomous Hermes Agent work. It combines a Kanban board and live streams of agent reasoning and tool execution with human verification of agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. A strict pipeline architecture and Master Orchestrator handle routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Hermes Agent Team is a local web system for coordinating Leader and Specialist agents through an automated task lifecycle. It integrates MCP and ACP for local tools and communication, with a real-time UI for agent dialogues and Kanban task flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: Hermes Agent Metaharness automates outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code and orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations. It also provides structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator runs an agent-versus-agent arena in which nine autonomous agents operate across two competing AI companies. Using Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, it displays agent tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics on a real-time dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: HermesAgent-MultiModel is a local Mixture-of-Agents framework that queries models in parallel and synthesizes their outputs, using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It is designed for consumer GPUs, is optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware, and does not require cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Codegraph builds a local project knowledge graph with `codegraph init`, then syncs it as files change. Its MCP server connects the graph to Hermes Agent and other coding agents, aiming to reduce token use and tool calls.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale tracks token usage and costs across Hermes and a range of other AI coding agents. It provides both a CLI and a visualization dashboard for reviewing that usage.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: Token Monitor provides a real-time view of token usage, costs, tool limits, and session details, reading Hermes Agent state alongside other CLI tools. It also offers historical trends, usage breakdowns, and multi-device sync.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: Claude Tap is a local trace viewer for coding-agent API traffic, including Hermes Agent requests. Inspect prompts, tool calls, streaming responses, and token usage, compare adjacent requests for context changes, and redact common auth headers before traces are recorded.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design skills, UI prompts, and layout guidance to help build interfaces with AI. It supports providers that accept Markdown or general prompting and connects to coding tools through its MCP server or plugins.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: Oh My Hermes is an installable workflow layer for building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes product-development and operations skills, plus a CTO loop with seven focused agents.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes Skins is a community CLI for custom and built-in themes for the Hermes terminal UI. Users can create skins with YAML files, and custom skins inherit unspecified values from the default skin.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang statically checks agent-facing content in project directories, including configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts, using HERM v1.1 scoring. Its findings include file locations and suggested fixes, with support for CI gates and reviewed baselines.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place describes itself as a social economy for autonomous AI agents. It supports encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol, identity registration with human-readable @handles, and commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel Browser is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control via MCP, with support for providers including Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama. Its supervisor sidebar manages agent approvals, checkpoints, and conversation threads, and it supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: Hermes-CCC ports Hermes Agent’s brain and 46 core skills to Claude Code Channel, where it runs without a separate process or OAuth. It also includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: Cognee Integrations is a monorepo of Cognee-owned integration packages with two tiers: a permanent knowledge graph and a session cache. Its Claude Code plugin auto-captures and auto-recalls context.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup combines RTK and Caveman templating for token-saving CLI workflows, with the project claiming 90–99% token savings. It also includes 40+ preconfigured skills for finance, DevOps, and research, plus automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md provides per-folder configuration and skills for creating scoped Hermes Agents, including project-local memories, tools, and instructions. It can switch between the default agent and a scoped agent, making it useful for keeping project-specific setups separate.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This project automates installation of hermes-agent and 12+ supporting services, with three deployment tiers ranging from a minimum viable setup to a production stack. It also supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers OpenClaw files—including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives—to Hermes. It also maps configurations and credentials to Hermes YAML and JSON formats and can set up systemd gateway services.
entries.doomsday-network/github-bounty-scanner: This Python 3 tool searches GitHub for issues labeled as bounties or mentioning USDC, wDOOM, or Algora, then sorts matches into three safety categories. It belongs in this list as a focused scanner for finding and filtering potential crypto bounty listings.
entries.doomsday-network/cuda-gpu-miner: This project provides a standalone pool miner that runs with Python and documents CUDA GPU mining. Its deployment instructions cover Docker, RunPod, and Vast.ai.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco monitors AI agent systems and can automatically recover them without a cloud dependency. Its native Hermes plugin exports conversation telemetry, while its monitoring modes include passive analysis and scheduled active probing.
entries.doomsday-network/doom-pay: DoomPay provides HTML and hosted checkout options for DOOM on Layer-1 and wDOOM on Base Mainnet. It also includes a Python SDK and MCP payment verification.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: Hermes Voice adds offline voice interaction to Hermes Agent without requiring API keys or accounts. It supports 35 languages via Piper and nine via Kokoro, with adaptive turn-taking and barge-in.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Hermes Startup is a local runtime that operates with zero network access by default and requires explicit approval for consequential actions and external writes. Its contracts cover opportunities, offer previews, and exact approvals.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This Hermes memory plugin supports semantic search and multidimensional memory storage, with tools to search, add, and delete memories. It also includes a circuit breaker for MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: CC-Switch is a cross-platform manager for Hermes Agent and several other agent tools, including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It lets users switch API providers in one click and manage MCP, Skills, and Prompts in one place, with support for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source cowork app for Hermes Agent and other agent CLIs, with 21 built-in professional assistants. It also supports remote access through a WebUI and messaging platforms, and runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI provides web and phone access to Hermes Agent, with a three-panel layout for sessions, chat, and workspace files. Its workspace file browser includes inline previews, and the project is designed for access through an SSH tunnel.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: Hermes Desktop is a desktop companion for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent, using the official Hermes install script. Its GUI manages profiles, sessions, skills, and tools; the app is available from the project website or GitHub Releases.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko Studio is a web dashboard for Hermes Agent that brings together chats, sessions, agent integrations, usage analytics, scheduled jobs, and channel configuration. It also offers visual workflows with schedules and approval gates, and is available as a desktop app, npm CLI, and Docker image.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: Hermes Workspace is a native web workspace combining chat, a terminal, a memory browser, a skills manager, and an inspector panel. Its highlights include Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers, plus a file browser with Monaco and a PTY terminal.
entries.spacering-net/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents, including Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode, as a desktop or self-hosted app. Users can import, search, resume, and hand off sessions, delegate across agents, or queue to-dos in worktrees.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace connects directly to Hermes hosts locally or over SSH, using real session data and an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair. It provides native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Hermes-CN-Desktop is a Windows-first Chinese desktop app for Hermes Agent, with support for Windows and macOS and native window and process management. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health-check and update capabilities, alongside interfaces for chat, memory management, and LaTeX/Markdown rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to a local or remote Hermes Agent runtime, including Hermes Cloud and self-hosted connections. Bot Mode supports agent switching and group chats, while Hermes Control is opt-in and Chromium-only.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app for driving a self-hosted Hermes agent, pairing with a hermes-webui server. It supports streamed chats and file or image attachments, and lets users browse, search, and resume server sessions and view scheduled tasks, skills, memory, and insights.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop AI agent workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw, plus custom LLM model routing. Its runtime dashboard tracks token usage and latency, while a live workspace shows code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It tracks agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs, and includes a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: Agent Sessions is a native macOS browser and cockpit for Hermes agents and other coding-agent CLIs. It lets users search local histories for prompts, tool calls, errors, and file paths, inspect session metadata and supported token or pricing details, and keeps session histories from being uploaded.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: Hermes Control Interface is a self-hosted, browser-based dashboard for the Hermes AI agent stack, with tools including a terminal, file explorer, session overview, and cron management. Its real-time chat visualizes tool calls, while its MCP control plane and ZOO Swarm Monitor support server lifecycle management and agent health and kanban tracking.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: Hermes Desktop OS1 is a native macOS workspace for Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It offers one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Hermes Agent Mission Control is a self-hostable dashboard template that connects a local Hermes agent to a web dashboard through a Postgres message bus. Its approval inbox is for requests with side effects; the project is built with Next.js 16, React 19, Prisma, and Tailwind CSS v4.
entries.liftaris/herm: Herm is an alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI that connects to the Hermes Agent gateway. Its tabs cover profiles, sessions, skills, cron, and memory, alongside kanban boards, task details, diagnostics, and dispatch controls.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: Hermes Telegram Mini App is a locally run, 10-page mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0. It includes terminal chat with streaming responses and file attachments, Telegram validation using dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication, and background spawning for up to five concurrent agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: Portable Hermes Agent packages Hermes Agent as a Windows desktop app with a dark-themed, multilingual GUI and session management. Its highlights include workflow automation, runtime tool creation, and local-model support through LM Studio.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: Hermes UI is a glassmorphic web interface for a self-hosted Hermes Agent, with chat and real-time log streaming. It also brings together a file browser, task tracking, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI is a process-monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes. It provides real-time session activity and cost tracking, inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, and read-only views of configuration and environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: PAN-UI is a self-hosted AI workspace centered on chat, with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It also offers a marketplace for discovering and installing skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profiles for separate sessions, memory, and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: Hermes Agent Desktop is a native desktop client for multi-agent collaboration, with streaming SSE responses and model switching. It features an orchestrator coordinating 20 specialized AI agents and a visual Skill Store with 50+ curated one-click installations.
entries.nicolasestrem/hermes-model-switcher: This plugin for the Hermes Agent Web Dashboard shows configured routes across profiles in one matrix, so you can compare them in one place. It previews changes before applying them and includes named presets and a guarded Undo.
entries.robbyczgw-cla/hermes-ui-plus: This unofficial, open-source chat client for a self-hosted Hermes Agent supports interactive answers such as checklists, choices, forms, rankings, and votes. It also provides command approvals and live tool-step updates, and runs on Android, web, and macOS, with Linux in alpha.
